274705748.description:
Natural Native Copper Nugget Specimen Raw Unrefined Metallic Mineral  Solid
This listing features a natural native copper specimen in the form of a nugget. The item is composed of raw, unrefined copper with an irregular, organic shape and metallic reddish-brown color typical of native copper. The nugget appears to be solid metal and shows natural surface textures and patina, indicative of its geological origin. There are no brand markings or manufacturer stamps, as this is a naturally occurring mineral specimen. The condition is natural and unaltered, suitable for mineral collectors, geology enthusiasts, or educational use.
